entries.2afc00141563e60a: It manufactures and sells a wide range of commercial kitchen equipment, combining in-house products such as heat equipment and work equipment with purchased products such as refrigeration equipment and cooking service equipment, as well as large bread-making machines for bread factories. entries.41b35db6b226c7c3: Its corporate philosophy is the “customer-first principle,” and as a comprehensive manufacturer of commercial kitchen equipment and large bread-making machines, its mission is “to provide higher-quality products and services at appropriate prices and to contribute to customers.” Its medium- to long-term management strategy aims to increase market share and establish the top position in the highly competitive commercial kitchen equipment industry. It calls for strengthening technological development and actively developing in-house products, strengthening direct sales and route sales, expanding sales to institutional catering and the prepared food industry, strengthening maintenance services across Japan, enhancing efficient production through the three-plant system of Maruzen Kogyo Co., Ltd., and developing customers among food manufacturers in other industries and overseas through Fujisawa Maruzen Co., Ltd.

entries.8f9cc500078110ca: The market in the restaurant and prepared food industries, its main customers, is said to be approximately ¥30 trillion a year, and total annual demand for commercial kitchen equipment is said to be approximately ¥760 billion for heat and cold equipment combined. In the heat equipment field, the market share of the seven major companies, including the company group, is still low, and there are many single-product manufacturers and local equipment contractors. Revenue from external customers by segment for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥63,159 million for the Commercial Kitchen Equipment Business, ¥3,131 million for the Large Bread-Making Machine Business and ¥491 million for the Building Leasing Business. Because revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, regional information is omitted, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
